description: This Java source file defines Swagger API documentation classes for the Standing Instruction API resource in the Apache Fineract project. It contains nested static classes representing various API responses, requests, and associated data models used for API documentation and client-server communication.

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionsTemplateResponse
classes.description: Response model for retrieving standing instructions template data including options and current data.

classes.name: GetFromOfficeResponseStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Model representing office information in standing instruction responses.

classes.name: GetFromAccountTypeResponseStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Model representing account type info in responses.

classes.name: GetFromOfficeOptionsResponseStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Options for source offices in standing instructions.

classes.name: GetStatusOptionsResponseStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Options for standing instruction status states.

classes.name: GetInstructionTypeOptionsResponseStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Options for instruction types (e.g., fixed, variable).

classes.name: GetStandingInstructionsResponse
classes.description: Response model for list of standing instructions with pagination.

classes.name: GetPageItemsStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Paged item representing individual standing instruction data.

classes.name: GetFromOfficeStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Source office info for individual standing instructions.

classes.name: GetFromClientStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Source client info for individual standing instructions.

classes.name: GetFromAccountTypeStandingInstructionSwagger
classes.description: Source account type info for individual standing instructions.
